description: Mediation Boards Commission - Invites fresh nominations for the Chairman & Mediators of the Matale and 6 other Districts' Panel of Mediation
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to judicial mediation boards under the Mediation Boards Act. It involves law enforcement and judicial administration by calling for nominations for judicial mediators across various districts, specifying eligibility criteria and appointment procedures through the Mediation Boards Commission, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters.
